newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: 3M sees plant, doubled sales in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: 3M sees plant, doubled sales in Argentina.

text.p: U.S. adhesives firm Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing Co will invest $20 million to build a plant in Argentina this year and expects to double sales in the country by 2000, senior company officials said in a newspaper interview published Thursday.
Company President Livio De Simone told La Nacion newspaper that investment has been slated for a special adhesives plant.
"Latin America as well as the Orient and Pacific are the key places to invest," De Simone said.
Mario Font Guido, general manager for the company in Argentina, said he expects sales to double in three years from their current level of $100 million.
